    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The trigger has aria-haspopup, aria-expanded and aria-controls; its name carries the model and whether thinking is on
      - listitem: Models are a listbox with options and aria-activedescendant, so focus stays on the list while the arrows move
      - listitem: Thinking and web search are switches, Effort is a radio group with one tab stop
      - listitem: While closed the menu is inert; the last row's numbers are announced politely once, not while they roll
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The menu opens with a short fade and a soft scale from the corner of the trigger, and closes the same way
      - listitem: Pointing at a model fills its bars segment by segment and steps the other rows back
      - listitem: Effort unfolds under the thinking switch; its soft fill slides to the chosen level, and the lit row's bars fill in blue
      - listitem: First-token time and price roll to their new values; the model name in the trigger crossfades and a small bulb unfolds next to it while thinking is on
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches without movement
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The menu is 320px wide and never wider than the screen minus 32px. Below 300px the row glyphs and key hints give way and the bars move closer
      - listitem: "Touch screens: taller trigger, rows, switches and effort buttons; the key hints are hidden"
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: The menu is positioned absolutely from the trigger – keep the composer's overflow visible, or the menu gets cut
      - listitem: Pick side="top" when the composer sits at the bottom of the viewport, and align="end" when the trigger is on the right
      - listitem: latencyMs is the time without thinking; the last row multiplies it by the effort (×1.6, ×2.5, ×4) while thinking is on
      - listitem: Keep descriptions to two or three words – the row has room for one short line next to the bars
